## Colophon

The dial on the front page is a simulated year of implied volatility: it builds into each scheduled announcement, such as earnings or a central bank decision, and falls once the news is out. Each draw places the announcements at new dates. It runs in your browser, a few hundred lines of plain JavaScript with no libraries. Every page and post also carries a short random walk seeded from its own address.

The site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org), and the [source is on GitHub](https://github.com/vlachosi/vlachosi.github.io).
